findings.reason: 原来源boot与当前认证、未知发送恢复、现有action outbox的重发语义需要区分。候选尚未实现，不作为源码缺陷。
findings.minimal_resolution: 当前enabled/boot在authority事务内复验，owner/worker由认证派生；无PLAN不要求read_scope或A01。原boot只留历史，当前同owner+worker可query旧receipt。raw UTF-8 digest、唯一owner/request及worker固定；私人decision CAS在发送前写SENDING，遗留SENDING/UNKNOWN及404仅query，不进原action outbox。
findings.decision_status: 主机已明确接受；无剩余人类决定

findings.reason: 重复采纳须与图后续head无关，当前角色校验和原子receipt不可依赖仅首次调用GraphPlans.change。
findings.minimal_resolution: 当前人类owner操作门禁先于receipt replay；同authority锁事务先查immutable adoption，再以稳定Change UUID调用expectedVersion=0的GraphPlans.change并CAS登记采纳。丢响应重放只返原plan/version，不覆盖编辑，不换plan；空Spec无执行能力。聚合读取先过原owner/角色边界。
findings.decision_status: 主机已明确接受；无剩余人类决定

findings.reason: 真实Delivery字段与ROOT出口需有同一可落实的核对链，完整图状态或命令文本不能替代证据。
findings.minimal_resolution: 在一致事实快照只取最终ROOT exports，复算exit/Fact/TaskInput/context/delivery原文摘要；精确Task+Attempt对照实际COMPLETED、base/result/changes、owner/plan/config与全部固定sources，不查latest补结果。ANSWER/空成果/缺版本/冲突/UNKNOWN如实标识。命令仅Worker原声明，不推断pass；不造Delivery。
findings.decision_status: 主机已明确接受；无剩余人类决定

implementation_constraints: Exact closed machine routes and explicit new UI authentication interception
Strict three-field projection and raw UTF-8 digest confirmation
Local decision CAS separate from existing action outbox
Current authorization before adoption replay and one atomic graph/receipt transaction
Same owner/role boundary before read-only aggregation
Final ROOT evidence and real task/attempt/context/config/source/delivery checks
No empty-set or command-text inference of delivery/pass
actual_interfaces_read: GraphPlans/GraphState and previously reviewed ROOT export algorithm
TaskInput and V12 execution context/delivery tables
data.alternatives_and_tradeoffs: Reuse inert proposal plus human GraphPlans adoption rather than granting secretary graph actions; retain exact read-only evidence checks rather than creating another delivery ledger. One explicit adoption and possible missing-evidence result are accepted costs.
commands_run: Three targeted static Get-Content/rg discovery batches
git status --short and git rev-parse HEAD only
One post-write static JSON/paired-artifact metadata check
evidence_limits: Design guidance only; GoalProposal/V16/adoption/aggregate not implemented
No independent implementation verdict or verification-passed event
No FD/source/state/Git changes or recursive delegation
